objective: Record the scheduler-provided GDN speculative request boundaries and state mapping for one-request and two-request execution after R81 proved that the current combined serial replay is not sufficient.

instrumentation.scope: First observed one-request and first observed multi-request speculative convolution call on each TP rank; host logging only.

decision: Use the trace only to verify request boundaries, packed-token ownership, state-cache-column layout, and accepted-prefix selection. Do not infer a repair or publish throughput from this instrumented run.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only. Any subsequent repair must pass exact varied-prompt identity, deterministic repeats, context-depth, concurrency, clean-boot, and speed-floor gates before public promotion.
